question: What is the supreme twelfth six-footed noble half-sentence?
premises: The hrīṃ-hūṃ mantra-body should come quickly without delay.
It should come to the end of the body.
This may be the noble half-sentence.
inference: The supreme twelfth six-footed noble half-sentence is the hrīṃ-hūṃ mantra-body coming quickly without delay to the end of the body.
uncertainties: The exact referent of "body-end" is unclear.
The parsing of the opening compound is uncertain.
plain_english: O body of the hrīṃ-hūṃ mantra, come quickly without delay to the end of the body; this may be the noble half-sentence, the twelfth, six-footed, supreme.
